refnamediv.refpurpose: Return the string representation of the current element

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public stringCachingIterator::__toString
Gets the string representation of the current element. What is returned depends on the flags of the CachingIterator:
CachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING
The current element converted to a &string;. The conversion is done when the iterator moves to the element.
CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_KEY
The key of the current element converted to a &string;.
CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_CURRENT
The current element converted to a &string;. The conversion is done when this method is called.
CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_INNER
The inner iterator converted to a &string;. The conversion is done when the iterator moves to the element, before the inner iterator is moved forward.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
The string representation of the current element.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a BadMethodCallException if none of CachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING, CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_KEY, CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_CURRENT and CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_INNER is set.
